title: Private complete selection-request receipt
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 SHA256 27bda43d8cb78ed800891c6793e5efd945ac64d94a83ceff8adaed10e8f67419: II.A PDF p19, II.D-04 p43–44, I.H p18, II.E-33/II.E-34 p73 (one-based). These clauses ground selection and hidden-zone semantics; they do NOT prescribe this software log format. This is a request-restoration/projection protocol, not a game action, card approval or cryptographic authentication. Reuse authoritative complete non-null pending and exact paused control-plane schemas, including typed resume data; do not introduce alternate generic bags or include events/players. Host seals after drain and revision update, binds each unique request ID to the exact request+work, rejects duplicates and keeps receipts private. Historical receipts require shape/private/unique-ID checks, not equality with current work. Structural privacy scanning is conservative, not detection of arbitrary re-encoding of private information.
